editionLabel: Gamelyn English base rules, official Dized reference
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently swung a sword goes first. Choosing the first player randomly is also an official option.
houseFallback: If the criterion leaves a tie, nobody qualifies, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested fallback.
clarifications: The starter receives the Active Player Token, selects an available action and takes that action or does nothing. Other players then respond in clockwise order.
Pass the token clockwise after the turn. In a five-player game, the player who clears the action card passes the token without taking an action; this is a later-turn adjustment.

internalEvidence: Read all 7 cached rule sections in full, including setup, turn sequence and relevant variants. Dized identifies Gamelyn Games as publisher and labels these rules publisher-maintained. Setup's Assign the Active Player Token paragraph states both sword recency and random selection. On Your Turn step 3 explicitly makes the active player act before the other players; this is not merely an administrative chooser. The two-player variant introduces the Lost Kingdom without replacing the initial criterion. Credits identify TEK08 and copyright 2014–2022, not a new publication date for this web reference.
